prerequisites.title: Slack account and workspace
prerequisites.detail: You need a workspace to own the app and install it to for testing.

prerequisites.title: HTTPS endpoints
prerequisites.detail: Apps open to other workspaces must use SSL on redirect and request URLs. The redirect URL itself must be HTTPS.

prerequisites.title: Test accounts and review contact
prerequisites.detail: For a web component, provide test accounts with login details. Provide a reliable email and phone number for the reviewer.

steps.title: Create the Slack app
steps.detail: Create the app in the Slack developer dashboard and install it to your workspace.
steps.done_when: The app exists and is installed in your workspace.

steps.title: Draft manifest with minimal scopes
steps.detail: Write the manifest with bot and user scopes under oauth_config.scopes, requesting only what the agent needs. Apps must demonstrate use of every scope.
steps.done_when: Manifest lists only scopes you can justify.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your Slack client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Add redirect URL in Slack
steps.detail: Paste the Composio redirect URI into Slack's OAuth & Permissions. It must be HTTPS and match what is sent.

steps.title: Complete checklist, activate distribution
steps.detail: Finish every item on Slack's checklist, then click Activate Public Distribution in Manage Distribution.
steps.done_when: You have a shareable install URL.

steps.title: Prepare review materials
steps.detail: Draft scope justifications, a demo script and an architecture diagram covering services that touch Slack. The diagram is optional but speeds review.

steps.title: Set up test accounts and submit
steps.detail: Create test accounts and test data, add a contact email and phone, then submit to the Marketplace.

steps.title: Wait for Slack review
steps.detail: Slack reviews the app and may ask follow-up questions. You are not told when testing happens.

steps.title: Test a connection end to end
steps.detail: Connect a Slack workspace through Composio and confirm the agent can act.

traps.title: Unlisted commercial apps get low rate limits
traps.detail: New installs of unapproved commercially distributed apps get 1 request per minute on conversations.history and conversations.replies. Existing installs from before May 29, 2025 are exempt.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: With the managed app users see Composio on the consent screen, and quota is shared across all Composio users.

traps.title: Some workspaces block unlisted apps
traps.detail: Some workspaces allow only Marketplace apps, and others require admin approval for installs.

traps.title: Changes after listing need resubmission
traps.detail: Changing scopes, endpoints or listing data after publishing requires review again. Material changes can lead to re-review or delisting.

blockers.symptom: Customer cannot install; admin approval required
blockers.what_it_means: The customer's workspace restricts installs to admins or requires approval.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's admin to approve the app request.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft a short explanation of the app and its scopes for the admin.

blockers.symptom: Rate limit errors on message history for new installs
blockers.what_it_means: The app is commercially distributed but not approved for the Marketplace.
